name: break-room
description: One question a day. Share a link, unlock your friends’ answers, and find your next favorite thing.

interface.longDescription:
Breakroom is a social app for sharing the parts of you that don’t fit in a bio. A song you can’t stop playing, an article that changed your mind, a video everyone needs to see. Answer the daily question with a link to unlock everyone else's answers.

Explore the most popular questions, give cigs to the answers you like, follow people you think are cool, and keep the conversation going with comments.

With Breakroom in ChatGPT, you can:
- Open today’s question and browse answers from the Breakroom community.
- Share a link as your answer to the daily question.
- Give cigs and comment on other people's answers.
- Find recommendations in past answers, from albums, to movies, to restaurants, and more.
- Check what’s new or turn on notifications to keep up with your friends' answers.

Your answer unlocks the day. Come back tomorrow for a new question.
defaultPrompt: What did my friends share on Breakroom today?

positive.expected_behavior: The Breakroom app opens in the sidebar to today's question, the answer composer, and the answer feed with All and Following scopes. If the user has not answered today, other people's answer details remain locked.

positive.description: Answer today's prompt with a link
positive.expected_behavior: A preview card shows today's question and the link with Post and Cancel controls. Nothing is published until the user presses Post, and the user can post only one answer per day.

positive.prompt: Find music for running on Breakroom
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the best matching snacks from Breakroom's daily answers, says who shared each, and explains why it fits. If the user has not answered today, it reports how many matches are locked and offers to answer today's prompt to unlock them.

positive.description: Check for news without opening the app
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT summarizes new answers from followed users, new cigs and comments on the user's answers, comments that mention the user, X friends who joined, and whether the user still needs to answer today's prompt. If nothing is new, it says so in one short line.

positive.prompt: Turn on Breakroom notifications in this chat
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that background push notifications need a cloud Work chat (select Work and Cloud on desktop), then attempts an event-triggered task for Breakroom's notification.created event in this chat. Notifications include the new daily prompt, answers from followed people, cigs, comments, mentions, followers, and friends joining. It reports real-time success only after Breakroom confirms the subscription is active. If and only if the event task is explicitly unsupported, it creates and acknowledges one hourly fallback task instead.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No Breakroom tool is called. ChatGPT answers without Breakroom.

negative.description: General shopping request not about snacks
negative.prompt: What are the best running shoes to buy right now?
negative.expected_behavior: No Breakroom tool is called, because the user did not ask about snacks on Breakroom.

negative.prompt: Tweet this link for me: https://example.com
negative.expected_behavior: No Breakroom tool is called. Breakroom cannot post to X, so ChatGPT explains it can't tweet.

publication.release_notes: Refreshes the Breakroom description and default prompts for today’s question, friends’ answers, and notification setup. Notification setup explains cloud Work chats and Push permissions. The hosted app also fixes day-picker styling, excess header spacing in narrow desktop panels, and search cards disappearing in fullscreen.
